title: Staggered questionnaire response automation + audit trail for enterprise security asks
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce time-to-first-response for enterprise security questionnaires (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires) by enabling a staggered, SLA-driven response flow that combines automated drafting, evidence autopopulation from internal stores, and a tamper-evident audit trail.

Scope:
- Build a runbook and orchestration layer in the Console that can emit an initial 'fast-path' partial response within 48 hours for P0/P1 accounts while tracking outstanding evidence items.
- Use an LLM-assisted drafting service (read-only knowledge base) to suggest answers for standard questions and generate an evidence checklist mapped to our internal artifacts (Confluence, Drive, audit logs).
- Provide H-I-T-L approval workflow for legal/security reviewers before final bundle is delivered.
- Persist an immutable audit trace (who did what, when; links to evidence bundles; redaction markers) surfaced in Console and included with customer deliverables.

Out of scope: full RFP automation, vendor-managed questionnaire portal integrations (initial phase), automated contractual amendments.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console can produce and send a partial response (minimally answered questionnaire with clear outstanding items) within target SLAs for test accounts (P0 within 48h, P1 within 5 business days).
- LLM-suggested answers are surfaced with provenance and a confidence score; reviewers can accept/modify/reject.
- Evidence autopopulator can attach at least three canonical artifacts (SOC2 report link, encryption KMS diagram, DPA template) when available and surface missing items.
- Audit trail records actions, reviewer approvals, and final PDF bundle generation; exported bundles include trace metadata.
- Metrics dashboard (Console) shows time-to-first-response, percent accepted without edits, and fraction of asks closed by autopopulated evidence.

Success metrics:
- Reduce median time-to-first-response from 7 days to <=48 hours for P0 accounts.
- Increase % of questionnaires delivered with autopopulated evidence from 12% to 50% for standard templates.

Stakeholders: Legal (Maya Singh), Security/Compliance (Diego Morales), Solutions Engineering (Priya Rao), Console PM (Liam O'Neill), Runtime ENG for evidence access (ENG-3321).

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EC/Staggered+Questionnaire+Runbook (draft)
